event_data.context: Tiber is a standalone x86_64 Linux-first development harness. OpenAI supplies inference only through codex app-server; Tiber owns sessions, agents, tasks, workflow, tools, memory, isolation, verification, delivery, CI recovery, and audit history. Deliver tiber/PRD.md, tiber/ARCHITECTURE.md, and nine decision records covering the locked architectural decisions.
event_data.summary: Define Tiber's product contract, authority boundaries, hard-cutover interface, architecture, threat model, effect catalogue, platform scope, and strict Rust lint policy before implementation.
event_data.title: Define Tiber and its architecture
